articles.title: Letters: Oak Street Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Oak Street for 32 years, and I want to say what a difference the Mill Hill Lions Club has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting.
Please keep the book exchange box in the budget. Many of us on Oak Street use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Stella Baptiste, Cedar Hollow
